examples.arabic: كلنا قعدنا قدام التلفزيون في الصالون بتاعنا.
examples.english: All of us sat in front of the television in our living room.
examples.transliteration: Kollena 2a3adna 2oddam el televiseon fi el saloon beta3na.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.english: Ahmed is in front of the house and the door is closed.
examples.transliteration: ahmed oddam el beit wa el baab makfool

examples.arabic: هو كان بيشرب قهوة قدام الباب
examples.english: He was drinking coffee in front of the door.
examples.transliteration: howa kan beyishrab ahwa oddam elbab

examples.arabic: بالمناسبة شوفت اخواتك امبارح قدام بيتي
examples.english: By the way I saw your siblings yesterday in front of my house
examples.transliteration: Belmonasba shoft akhwatak embareh oddam beiti

examples.arabic: فجاة شفت صاحبي القديم محمود قدام المخبز
examples.english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Mahmoud in front of the bakery.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa shoft sahby el adeem Mahmoud oddam el makhbaz.

examples.arabic: كل يوم جمعة العيلة كلها بتتجمع قدام التليفزيون عشان تتفرج على ماتش المنتخب
examples.english: Every Friday, the whole family gathers in front of the TV to watch the national team's match.
examples.transliteration: kol yom gom3a el 3eila kolaha btetgama3 oddam el telvezyon 3ashan tetfarag 3ala matsh el montakhab
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family
